'''Aveca Dunn''', also known as '''Vex''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who often worked for the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], but also worked for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], she was hired by [[Rodas Borgin]] to kidnap [[Bron Dooku]] but was stopped by her former lover [[Jahan Cross]].

==Biography==
Vex was a freelance operative who often worked for both the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. She also became a lover to Imperial agent, Commander [[Jahan Cross]].<ref name="AOTE8:HT3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref>

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Vex was hired by Duke [[Rodas Borgin]] to kidnap [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]].<ref name="AOTE9:HT4">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref> In her first attempt she hired the services of a lover, Captain [[Ramchak]] and his crew of the ''[[Bloodskull]]'' to attack the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] while she would take the young Count. However her former lover, Cross was onboard the ''Windrunner''. Vex was able to take the young Count unconscious to one of Ramchak's [[IRD-A starfighter|starfighters]]<ref name="AOTE7:HT2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref>

[[File:Vex_HT3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Aveca Dunn]]
However she was pursued by Cross. Vex then took the young Count to the freighter ''[[Starhaven]]'' at the [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]] [[Carannia Spaceport/Legends|Spaceport]]. Once there she was confronted by Cross, who disabled the ship. Vex tried to fight Cross, but was subdued by him, and then they shared a kiss. Cross was able to convince her to act comatose and to await her rescue. Vex was them taken to [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|the Spike]] for interrogation. Soon, Vex was rescued by Cross. Vex put on a guard's uniform and the two of them made their way out. Unfortunately, Vex was discovered by Count Dooku's Security Chief, Captain [[Candra Tymon]], but Cross was able to knock her out. They were able to escape the Spike by getting Tymon to a med center. Vex was then able to get off planet. Before leaving, Vex told Cross that Duke Borgin was the one who hired her.<ref name="AOTE8:HT3" />

Vex then hired bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to finish her job of kidnapping the young Count.<ref name="AOTE9:HT4" /> This was in fact done at the behest of Jahan Cross as part of his scheme to fake Bron's death, although Fett believed that Borgin actually hired him.<ref name="AOTE10:HT5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The cover of [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]] depicts Vex with red hair. However, internally she is consistently depicted with brown hair. The cover also incorrectly depicts [[Alessi Quon]]'s skin color.
